old: NY basis; New Orleans, Miami, Antwerp, Hamburg/Bremen -125 pts
plain_english: Houston becomes a delivery port at the same 1.25c discount as the other non-NY ports.
source_note: NYBOT Coffee C rules (Schedule C-3 for March 2005 and later)

old: Honduras, Venezuela, Peru -100; Burundi, India, Rwanda -300; Colombia +200; DR, Ecuador -400
new: Mexico, Central America, Kenya, PNG, Tanzania, Uganda, Panama, Peru, Honduras at basis; Venezuela, India -100; Burundi, Rwanda -300; Colombia +200; DR, Ecuador -400
plain_english: Origin schedule in force for most of the 2005-2016 period (Brazil not deliverable).
source_note: NYBOT Coffee C rules (Schedule C-2 for July 2005 and later)

new: coffee showing any hint of aging in the cup fails grading
plain_english: Graders reject coffee that tastes aged, which limits how long a lot can stay deliverable in practice.
source_note: SCA News, citing rulebook amendment of Apr 15, 2009 (eff. Apr 24, 2009)

new: Brazil semi-washed arabica deliverable at -900 pts (9c under)
plain_english: Brazil semi-washed becomes deliverable at a 9c discount (approved by the ICE board Dec 9, 2010).
source_note: ICE press release Dec 9 2010; Appendix IV footnote (amended Dec 9 2010; eff. March 2013)

old: 721-1080 days: 825 pts + 75 per 30 days; over 1080: 1725 + 100 per 30 days
new: 721-1080: 825 + 100 per 30 days; then 125, 150 ... 300 pts per 30 days in steps of 360 days (2025 pts at 1080 days, 3525 at 1440, 18825 at 3600)
plain_english: Discounts on coffee more than two years old become much steeper.
source_note: Appendix V items (4)-(15), amended Dec 9 2010, effective with March 2013; earlier schedule from the NYBOT rulebook

new: Port of Virginia added at basis (same as New York)
plain_english: Virginia becomes a delivery port at par with New York.
source_note: Schedule C-3 footnote: amended Jul 9 2014, eff. Jul 29 2014

plain_english: Colombia premium doubles to 4c; Brazil discount narrows to 6c (announced March 2014).
source_note: Comunicaffe Apr 11 2016; Schedule C-2 footnote amended Feb 27 2014, eff. May 2016

new: invoice adjusted by NY average load-out rate minus the delivering warehouse's load-out rate
plain_english: Warehouses with dear load-out charges pay the receiver the difference to New York.
source_note: Appendix V footnote: amended Mar 23 2017, eff. Apr 12 2017, July 2017 and later

new: New Orleans, Miami, Houston -50 pts; Antwerp, Hamburg/Bremen, Barcelona -125 pts; NY and Virginia basis
plain_english: US Gulf and Miami discount narrows from 1.25c to 0.50c; European ports stay at 1.25c.
source_note: Schedule C-3 footnote: amended Mar 23 2017, eff. Apr 12 2017, May 2019 delivery and later (old value from the NYBOT rulebook)

new: invoice adjusted by (NY average storage rate minus delivering warehouse storage rate) x 2 (Mar, May, Jul) or x 3 (Sep, Dec)
plain_english: Cheap-rent warehouses add to the invoice, dear ones deduct.
source_note: Appendix V footnote: amended Mar 23 2017, eff. Apr 12 2017, May 2019 and later

rule_area: Re-grading of de-certified coffee (Rule 8.10(a); Appendix II(b))
old: de-certified coffee could be resubmitted and got a new certificate with a new date, wiping out the age discount
new: coffee previously submitted for grading may not be resubmitted (appeals only)
plain_english: Ends the de-cert / re-cert route: the age discount now sticks to the lot for life.

new: coffee in Antwerp, Barcelona, Hamburg/Bremen must be non-customs-cleared to be graded; certs that clear customs lose their certificate
plain_english: Only bonded (non-cleared) coffee can sit in European certified stocks.

new: coffee in EU ports with bill of lading on/after Jun 29 2023, submitted for grading before Dec 30 2026 and without validated EUDR due-diligence data: discount 25 pts per month from Jan 2027 (2027 months); 300 pts + 50 per month from Jan 2028
plain_english: EU-port certs without EUDR paperwork lose value from the March 2027 contract; legacy stocks (B/L before Jun 29 2023) exempt.
source_note: Appendix VIII adopted May 15 2024 (eff. Jun 3 2024); discount paragraphs amended Nov 14 2024 (eff. Dec 3 2024); later amendments Sep 10 2025 and Dec 5 2025

new: also: coffee in New York, Virginia, New Orleans, Houston, Miami must be customs cleared and free of import duties, taxes and tariffs
plain_english: US-port certs must be duty paid, so any US tariff on an origin is borne by the coffee before grading.
source_note: Appendix VII amended Apr 8 2025, effective Apr 8 2025

old: KC listed up to 60 months out
new: no KC futures listed beyond March 2028; Coffee C Metric (AC) from May 2028
plain_english: March 2028 is the last KC delivery; from May 2028 the benchmark is the metric contract.
source_note: ICE Submission 25-157 (Aug 21 2025), citing Submission 25-130; rulebook Chapter 8 notice

rule_area: EUDR: validated due-diligence data (Appendix VIII para 1)
new: non-legacy coffee submitted for grading in EU ports on/after Dec 30 2026 must have Validated DDI; certificate revoked if it becomes invalid
plain_english: From 30 Dec 2026, new EU-port gradings need EUDR due-diligence data; older transition stock stays deliverable at a growing discount.
source_note: Appendix VIII para 1 amended Sep 10 2025 (eff. Nov 26 2025); further amendment Dec 5 2025 (eff. Dec 26 2025)

rule_area: Origin differentials: premiums for top washed origins
old: Colombia +400; Costa Rica, Kenya, Guatemala basis
plain_english: Colombia, Costa Rica and Kenya deliver at 10c over the futures and Guatemala at 5c over, from the March 2026 contract (in force now). The rulebook prints the May 2027 schedule after this one; May 2027 only adds Vietnam.
source_note: ICE notice Jan 16 2024; rulebook Schedule C-2 note 'Amended by the Board December 20, 2023; effective February 12, 2024 [with the March 2026 contract]'; ICE product specification page lists the premiums as current

new: Vietnam washed arabica deliverable at -600 pts
plain_english: Vietnam washed arabica becomes deliverable at a 6c discount (same as Brazil), from the May 2027 contract.
source_note: ICE Submission 25-51 (Apr 1 2025), effective Apr 15 2025, from the May 2027 contract

new: AC: 10 t, US$/t; bags or FIBCs up to 1 t; Barcelona dropped; differentials are the KC ones converted to $/t; spot-month limit 850 lots (8,500 t)
plain_english: From May 2028 coffee is delivered on the metric contract (AC). Values are the same as KC to within rounding; the changes are lot size, big bags and Barcelona.
